name: mcp-guard
description: Offline, evidence-linked auditing and inventory drift for a documented subset of MCP servers

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test tests/bounded-scan.test.mjs tests/cli.test.mjs tests/inventory.test.mjs tests/reporting.test.mjs tests/scanner.test.mjs tests/source.test.mjs
scripts.discovery:demo: npm run build && node dist/cli.js discover --fixture reviewed --approve-execution --format json
scripts.test:discovery: npm run build && node --test tests/isolation.test.mjs tests/discovery.test.mjs
scripts.validate:all: npm run validate && npm run test:discovery
